name: Ubuntu Session Titles
description: Generate concise Simplified Chinese session titles in PI-Desktop on Ubuntu, with a configurable prompt, model, and thinking level.
author: StrongHE; upstream by Lan

en.name: Ubuntu Session Titles
en.description: Generate concise Simplified Chinese session titles in PI-Desktop on Ubuntu, with a configurable prompt, model, and thinking level.
en.safetyNotes: After an eligible completed turn, bounded excerpts of the first user prompt and assistant reply are sent to the selected model through PI-Desktop's completion API. Each title generation may consume a model completion. Requires agent.complete and session.autoTitle; manual renames are preserved. Disable the original Session Titles plugin before enabling this fork to avoid duplicate requests.

zh-CN.name: Ubuntu 会话标题
zh-CN.description: 面向 Ubuntu 上的 PI-Desktop，默认生成便于检索的简体中文会话标题，支持自定义提示词、模型和思考级别。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 符合条件的回合完成后，通过 PI-Desktop 补全 API 将首条需求和首条回复的有限摘录发送给所选模型，每次生成可能消耗一次模型调用。需要 agent.complete 和 session.autoTitle 权限，保留手动改名。启用前请停用原版「会话标题」，避免重复请求。
